kept.excerpt: Gerasimov also reiterated his claim that Russian forces are advancing west from Kupyansk towards Shevchenkove, though Russian forces have not yet seized Kupyansk and do not currently have any consolidated advances in the town besides limited infiltration zones. A source reporting on the Russian Northern Grouping of Forces (GoF) acknowledged on July 18 that Ukrainian forces again control Kupyansk-Vuzlovyi (just south of Kupyansk) after Russian forces previously conducted infiltration missions to the settlement.
kept.publisher: Institute for the Study of War
kept.relevance: The latest eligible ISW assessment describes limited Russian infiltration around nearby Kupyansk and Ukrainian clearance of another settlement, providing context for entry and persistence risks around Moskovka.

kept.excerpt: Russian forces continued offensive operations in the Kupyansk direction on July 16 and 17 but did not advance. A spokesperson for a Ukrainian brigade operating in the Kupyansk direction reported on July 17 that Russian forces are relying on infiltration tactics and launching KAB glide bomb and drone strikes against Ukrainian forces and civilian targets in an attempt to undermine Ukrainian rear positions.
kept.publisher: Institute for the Study of War
kept.relevance: This establishes the recent lack of assessed advances while identifying infiltration as a locally relevant mechanism that could produce qualifying ISW shading.

kept.excerpt: Russian forces continued limited offensive operations in the Kupyansk and Borova directions on July 15 and 16 but did not advance. Geolocated footage published on July 16 shows Russian forces striking a Ukrainian position west of Holubivka (just north of Kupyansk), an area where Russian sources previously claimed that Russian forces maintained positions.
kept.publisher: Institute for the Study of War / AEI Critical Threats Project
kept.relevance: Geolocated Ukrainian positions near Kupyansk help constrain the local Russian presence and demonstrate why unsupported territorial claims cannot establish qualifying entry.

kept.excerpt: Geolocated footage published on July 14 shows Ukrainian forces striking a Russian position in central Kupyansk after what ISW assesses was a Russian infiltration mission. Mashovets acknowledged that small Russian infiltration groups are in Kupyansk but emphasized that Russian forces do not exercise physical control over the areas where they operate. Mashovets reported that Russian numerical superiority, Russian use of foliage for concealment, and the dense urban environment are slowly deteriorating the Ukrainian tactical situation near the Russian foothold in the Kupyansk direction.
kept.publisher: Institute for the Study of War
kept.relevance: This supplies evidence of successful local infiltration and its tactical enablers, relevant because assessed infiltration areas can qualify under the specified resolution rules.

kept.excerpt: Russian troops are trying to expand their presence along the state border of Ukraine, using the tactics of small assault groups and seeking new areas for penetration. The situation remains most tense in the Lyman and Kupiansk directions. This was reported by Viktor Trehubov, spokesperson of the Joint Forces Group, during a telethon broadcast, as reported by UNN.
kept.relevance: A contemporaneous report quoting a Ukrainian military spokesperson corroborates continued pressure and small-group penetration attempts in the broader Kupiansk sector.

search_notes: Frozen cutoff: 2026-07-18. Selected five dated reports published July 15–18, 2026; publication dates were visible in indexed source headings or article date lines. Excluded later-dated material, undated pages, and prediction-market or betting pages. web_fetch failed because of a provider configuration error; the requested agent-reach fallback also failed because its web backends were temporarily unavailable. Excerpts therefore rely on source text exposed by web_search, with quotations normalized only for spacing and removed footnote markers. The evidence concerns the surrounding Kupyansk sector; it does not independently establish Moskovka's municipal-boundary intersection with any qualifying ISW layer or persistence across consecutive finalized updates. No frozen July 18 map-layer snapshot was verified, and the market-creation date was not supplied.
